problem: The finance director (P-02) has no portfolio-level view. E4/E5 produced intelligence for one collector at a time; there is no dashboard showing what the book is worth, where value concentrates, or how recovery is trending.
value: First surface that shows the *portfolio* — the view that justifies the system to the person who funds it. Enables RF-06.1 (KPI cards) and RF-06.2 (segmentation charts) with ES-first copy and visible staleness (scored_at).
approach: Create a new `/[locale]/executive` page as a server component that fetches KPIs from `GET /api/v1/scenarios/{id}/kpis`. Build KPI cards and three hand-rolled SVG/CSS segmentation charts (days-overdue buckets, amount ranges, score categories). Add API client typed from s6.1-payload.json. Update sidebar executive link from `#` to the new route. Add ES/EN i18n keys with full parity. All components use Vitest mocks — no backend dependency for tests.

decisions.title: Server component for data fetching, client component for charts
decisions.rationale: Next.js app router pattern: page.tsx (server) fetches data, passes to ExecutiveDashboard (client) which composes interactive SVG charts. Matches existing patterns in cases/page.tsx and scenarios/page.tsx.

decisions.title: Types derived from s6.1-payload.json, not hand-written
decisions.rationale: s5.1 shipped a defect because every layer inherited one assumption read from domain classes. The captured s6.1 payload is the contract — TypeScript types must mirror it exactly. Prevents silent contract drift.

decisions.title: Hand-rolled SVG/CSS charts — no charting library
decisions.rationale: Per E6 scope §Architecture decisions: charting is not an ADR; design.md §Charting specifies hand-rolled SVG/CSS. Keeps bundle size minimal and avoids supply chain risk. Three simple bar charts need ~100 LOC total.

decisions.title: 409 unscored scenario → actionable empty state with 'Score this scenario' CTA
decisions.rationale: ADR-009: zeros are a failure mode. An unscored scenario must show an actionable empty state, not a dashboard of zeros. The CTA navigates to the scoring page (existing `/scenarios` or a new score endpoint).

decisions.title: scored_at visible on every dashboard view
decisions.rationale: ADR-009 §Alternatives: surface scored_at in the UI. Visible staleness over silent inconsistency. Director can judge if dashboard reflects current scores.

decisions.title: Sidebar executive link uses dynamic locale from usePathname
decisions.rationale: MainLayout is a client component (uses useTranslations). Can use next-intl/navigation's usePathname to construct the correct localized href. Ensures ES/EN routing works correctly.

acceptance_criteria.description: Dashboard shows four KPI cards: total overdue, expected recoverable, cases by category (high/medium/low), recovery rate (actual and expected)
Three segmentation charts render: days-overdue buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+), amount ranges (quartile labels), score categories (high/medium/low)
scored_at timestamp is visible on the dashboard for scored scenarios
Unscored scenario (409 response) shows actionable empty state with 'Score this scenario' link/button that navigates to scoring
Sidebar executive link navigates to /[locale]/executive (not #) and works for both ES and EN locales
All executive dashboard copy keys exist in both es.json and en.json with parity
Dashboard renders within NFR-02 budget at 500 clients / 2,000 invoices

drift_risks.description: Risk of duplicating formatting logic (currency, numbers) that exists in cases/components. Mitigation: reuse or extract shared formatting utilities from '@/lib/utils' or cases components.
drift_risks.mitigation: Audit existing formatting in CaseTable and ScenarioCard before writing new formatters. Extract shared currency/number formatting to lib/utils if not already there.

drift_risks.description: New executive module touches page, API client, types, 3 components, layout, i18n — 7+ files. Moderate fan-out but each file has single responsibility.
drift_risks.mitigation: Keep components pure and composable. ExecutiveDashboard composes KpiCard + SegmentationChart; page only fetches and routes. No cross-component state.
